notablePrerequisites: Chromatic Orrery does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Bring to Life by paying {3}, causing Chromatic Orrery to become a 0/0 artifact creature and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {2}, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability.
